entities.summary: Ninite is a package management system that lets users automatically install popular applications for their Windows operating system. It allows users to make a selection from a list of applications and bundles the selection into a single installer executable. It is free for personal use, while a paid version, Ninite Pro, is available for professional use. Ninite has been featured on Der Standard and PC Magazine.
